review_evidence: Complete primary inventory covers 422 Lean files; 128 files contain 384 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations, with the remainder dominated by Lean Game declarations, level metadata, imports, and tactic/game infrastructure.

The repository is a mathematics-learning game whose active and inactive levels encode propositional logic, sets, functions, cardinality, number theory, linear algebra, topology, and related checked exercises.

Paths named test, inactive, deprecated, playground, and the .sofi test fixtures were not treated as deletion classes: inspection shows they remain Lean game/formal-development material, and no narrower lossless selector was established.
summary: Retain the complete Robo/Scribble game unit as searchable mathematical tutorial and formal-development prior art.
